response.query: What assumed effect size (odds ratio) between low and high motivation should we use to power detection of nonadherence (PDC<80%)?
response.answer: To power detection of nonadherence (PDC<80%), an odds ratio of 1.5 between low and high motivation is typically assumed. This effect size is commonly used in studies focusing on medication adherence.
